IN.label: Annual 2025 border arrivals and departures • all travel purposes
IN.inboundMetricLabel: Foreign Tourist Arrivals by source country / territory
IN.outboundMetricLabel: Indian Nationals’ Departures by destination country / territory
IN.note: Official Bureau of Immigration annual 2025 border movements, published in India Tourism Statistics 2026. Departures include holiday, diaspora, business, education and pilgrimage travel and repeat trips; they are not unique holidaymakers or November/December 2026 demand. Vietnam is #13 and Hong Kong #22 among individually reported destinations; search includes all reported markets. Shares are calculated from published counts and the national total.

comparison2024.description: Ministry of Tourism written Rajya Sabha reply, 7 August 2025; Bureau of Immigration country-wise annex

methodology.ranking: Descending count of individually reported country and territory rows in Annex A2.1 / A3.2. Region subtotals and the unallocated Others row excluded from ranking. Territories such as Hong Kong remain separate because the source reports them separately.
methodology.share: value / national annual total × 100, rounded to two decimal places. The published source share is preserved separately and may use coarser rounding.
methodology.outbound: Indian Nationals’ Departures are border departure movements by Indian nationals, across all recorded travel purposes. They are not unique Indian holidaymakers. One person can generate multiple departures. Destination country/territory is distinct from the traveller’s nationality.
methodology.inbound: Foreign Tourist Arrivals are India’s foreign-national arrival series, not state/city tourist visits and not the broader International Tourist Arrivals series that also includes non-resident Indian nationals.
methodology.leisure: Purpose shares are published country-level percentages for 2025. Estimated leisure departures multiply total departures by the rounded leisure percentage; these estimates are not separately published exact counts.
methodology.period: Annual 2025 history, not November/December 2026 measured flows or forecasts.

sourceConsistencyNotes: Country-level Annex A3.2 used for rankings and the 2024 comparison. Its 2024 United States, Thailand, Vietnam, Canada, Kuwait, Oman and Malaysia values agree with the August 2025 PIB country-wise release.

The summary Table 3.1.2 and nearby narrative contain inconsistent 2024 country/value pairings; the country annex is the evidence used here. In the verified country annex, Thailand moves from fourth in 2024 to third in 2025; the US moves from third to fourth.
The aggregate regional rows are excluded. The 2026 annex includes some apparent regional subtotal inconsistencies, so country rows are not replaced with regional summaries.

cityRanking.status: No comparable India-origin city visitation ranking verified across these destination markets.
cityRanking.note: A departure airport or arrival gateway is not a city visited. Generic destination highlights and holiday hubs must be labelled as suggestions, not India-specific visitor rankings. Country ranks cannot be applied to cities.

inbound.note: The individually reported inbound rows plus the published unclassified category are two arrivals below the published national total. Counts are preserved as printed; no allocation or correction is invented.
